Why prayer is about connection, not about getting results.

Kevin Trudeau says many people feel abandoned at some point, separate from something bigger than themselves, and they ask why they are going through hard times.

He explains that the aim of prayer is not to get what you ask for. It is to feel connected to your source, so that the sense of aloneness and fear fades and you feel loved and protected.

In Kevin's words, that feeling brings calm, certainty and joy beyond understanding.

When do you feel most connected to something bigger than yourself?
